Interface ZephyrWalletListenerI

  • Method Details

    • onSyncProgress

      void onSyncProgress(long height, long startHeight, long endHeight, double percentDone, String message)
      Invoked as the wallet is synchronized.
      Parameters:
      height - - height of the synced block
      startHeight - - starting height of the sync request
      endHeight - - ending height of the sync request
      percentDone - - sync progress as a percentage
      message - is a human-readable description of the current progress

    • onNewBlock

      void onNewBlock(long height)
      Invoked when a new block is added to the chain.
      Parameters:
      height - - the height of the new block (i.e. the number of blocks before it).

    • onBalancesChanged

      void onBalancesChanged(BigInteger newBalance, BigInteger newUnlockedBalance, String assetType)
      Invoked when the wallet's balances change, once per asset whose balance changed.
      Parameters:
      newBalance - - new wallet balance of the asset in atomic units
      newUnlockedBalance - - new unlocked wallet balance of the asset in atomic units
      assetType - - the asset whose balance changed (an open string, see ZephyrAssets)

    • onOutputReceived

      void onOutputReceived(ZephyrOutputWallet output)
      Invoked 3 times per received output: once when unconfirmed, once when confirmed, and once when unlocked.

      The unconfirmed notification carries no asset type (the core does not pass it for pool outputs); the confirmed and unlocked notifications do. Use onBalancesChanged or getTxs() for the asset of an unconfirmed output.

      Parameters:
      output - - the received output

    • onOutputSpent

      void onOutputSpent(ZephyrOutputWallet output)
      Invoked twice per spent output: once when confirmed and once when unlocked.
      Parameters:
      output - - the spent output
